subject: Cross-border SI technical ops liaison and residency decision
messages:
From: Lena Schroeder <lena.schroeder@heimtech.de>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@apac-consult.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 17:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border SI pilot — initial ops questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. Before we lock the pilot SOW we need clarity on two items from the ops side so our legal and infra teams can approve: 

1) Data residency model: for the German pilot tenant, can tokens and persistent logs be pinned to an EU-only enclave (no egress to us regions)? We saw reference to "regional variants" in the docs but need explicit confirmation and a short list of what is stored outside EU (if anything).

2) Deployment pattern for local SI support: HeimTech will run the integration layer and orchestration in our Frankfurt VPC but we'd like to confirm the supported connectivity modes to Redwood Private control plane (VPC peering, PrivateLink, or customer-managed VPN). We prefer PrivateLink but need to confirm if Redwood supports it for private deployments in eu-central-1.

I've attached our minimal residency checklist to speed reviews. Copied Arjun from our APAC partner as he'll run the Singapore side questions.

Best,
Lena
Head of Integrations
HeimTech GmbH

Attachments: regional-residency-checklist-v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Schroeder <lena.schroeder@heimtech.de>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@apac-consult.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border SI pilot — initial ops questions

Hi Lena — great questions, thanks for sending the checklist. Short answers up front: yes on EU-only tenant options for persistent logs & tokens (we surface an "EU enclave" deployment for pilots), and yes we support PrivateLink into the Private control plane in eu-central-1.

I'll route the technical specifics to our infra lead (cc'd: Hiro) and legal/eng will confirm which telemetry fields still traverse control-plane channels (we try to minimize anything that leaves the region). Marissa/Vanessa — can you confirm commercial/contract implications if HeimTech wants a Frankfurt-resident tenant + Redwood Private control plane connection? There may be an add-on for dedicated VPC hosting in some cases.

Next steps I propose:
- Hiro to outline connectivity and exact data flows (today we have a conservative list of control-plane metadata that is not customer content).
- Marissa to confirm SOW line items and pricing for a regional tenancy + PrivateLink.
- I'll prepare a short one-page note for HeimTech summarizing the residency guarantees and the connectivity options.

I'll attach the draft SOW for visibility (internal draft).

—Karthik
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sow-draft-heimtech.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Karthik/Vanessa — forwarding for pricing and contracting. Quick notes after skim: 
- If HeimTech requires a fully isolated EU tenant with dedicated routing and PrivateLink, we should categorize this as a Dedicated/Private onboarding (adds onboarding fee + monthly reserved capacity).
- Need to check whether APAC Consult will mirror the same model in SG (if they require onshore residency there, that's separate commit).
- Please flag any procurement or SOC2 evidence they will request — we should be ready to offer SOC2 report + network diagrams + KMS flow.

I'll draft the SOW redlines and flag commercial impact. Vanessa, can you coordinate a single pricing page we can send to both partners? I can handle the legal/terms redline.

Marissa Cole

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lena Schroeder <lena.schroeder@heimtech.de>, Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@apac-consult.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 07:42:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border SI pilot — connectivity and control-plane telemetry

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 07:42 +09:00, Hiro Tanaka wrote:
Thanks for the clear checklist, Lena. Technical clarifications: 

1) Data residency: For the pilot we can enable an EU-resident tenant where customer content (requests, responses, embedding vectors, KV cache, logs marked as customer-content) remains in eu-central-1 storage/backends. Control-plane telemetry (heartbeat, health pings, usage counters) will still call home to our control plane in eu-central-1 if you pick a regional Private control plane; nothing routes through us-west unless you explicitly choose a multi-region fallover policy.

2) Connectivity: PrivateLink is supported. Options: 
  - Preferred: AWS PrivateLink (interface endpoints) into our Private control plane endpoints in eu-central-1 (recommended for lowest blast radius).
  - Alternate: customer-managed VPN with specific CIDR allowlists to a Redwood NAT gateway in the region.
  - Not recommended: public egress through NAT + TLS only — this will require additional cert & audit work on HeimTech side.

3) Implementation notes:
  - We will provide network diagrams + sample CloudFormation for PrivateLink set up.
  - KMS: we support customer-managed CMKs via AWS KMS in the same region; key policies need an allow for Redwood service principal (we'll supply the template).

If HeimTech confirms PrivateLink + EU enclave tenant, we can provision a pilot tenant in ~10 business days (subject to SOW sign-off).

Hiro Tanaka
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Schroeder <lena.schroeder@heimtech.de>, Arjun Menon <arjun.menon@apac-consult.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 15:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Cross-border SI pilot — deployment model decision & residency checklist

Lena/Arjun — thanks, this is helpful and actionable. Summary and next steps: 

1) Redwood confirms EU-resident tenant option. Customer content will remain in eu-central-1. Control-plane telemetry will remain in eu-central-1 for regional Private control plane (no US egress).

2) Connectivity: we recommend AWS PrivateLink; Hiro will share network diagram + PrivateLink CF template.

3) Commercials: Marissa will send a pricing summary and SOW redlines (expect an add-on for dedicated regional tenancy + onboarding).

4) Timeline: upon SOW sign, estimated provisioning ~10 business days.

Please reply with which connectivity option you prefer (PrivateLink, VPN) and confirm if HeimTech needs us to include specific SOC2/diagram docs in the SOW packet. We'll lock the SOW and a technical runbook once you confirm.

Best,
Karthik
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
